notes.title: Added partial controller support
notes.content:
Added partial gamepad support!
To start the game, you will need a keyboard and mouse!
Use the mouse to adjust the music and effects!
In the game itself, you can use the gamepad to control the character, try using sticks and buttons.
You can turn, shoot and jump, as well as it is possible to move the character without turning it allows you to shoot and retreat (backward movement).
